findings.rule: outcome not taught or not tested
findings.evidence: Bundle KC: ‘use dot-and-cross diagrams to illustrate ionic, covalent and coordinate bonding including the representation of any compounds stated in 3.4 and 3.5’. Pack item 9701-3.7-i01 asks ‘Identify the correct outer-shell dot-and-cross representation of MgO.’ The chapter questions ask learners to identify/select/count features, but none asks them to draw or construct a dot-and-cross diagram for any of the three bonding types.
findings.fix: Add at least one question requiring learners to draw dot-and-cross diagrams for ionic, covalent and coordinate bonding, including a compound from 3.4/3.5.
